jobs.description:
**Opportunity Overview:**  

Cohere Health's brand and marketing needs span a wide range: product marketing, corporate marketing, sales, event management, content development, client communications, and more. As such, this role offers a tremendous opportunity for a creative, energetic, and curious person to make an immediate impact on Cohere's growth. Reporting to the Manager of Marketing Operations in India, and working closely with the Manager of Corporate Marketing and Design Specialist in the US, you will be instrumental in developing visual communications across the company.


**What you'll do:**


* **Design branded digital, multimedia, and offline marketing materials**. You will conceptualise and design materials that enhance the Cohere Health brand narrative and drive response across each of our marketing channels, including:
* + Video design and production
	+ Slide decks/presentations
	+ Website and social media graphics
	+ Sales collateral
* **Design standards and systems**.You will contribute to the development of Cohere Health's style and component library. You'll work closely with Cohere Health's US marketing team, including the Design Specialist, to ensure consistency across our brand designs.
* **Stay on top of graphic design trends**. Because Cohere Health highly values design thinking, we'll need you to be a student of design trends that may impact our product or brand. Ever curious, you'll also monitor our competitors and how they leverage design in both their marketing and their products.
* **Produce multimedia content.** Help tell Cohere's story through video to connect with audiences and highlight our brand.


**Required Qualifications:**


**Must\-haves**


* 2\-3 years of experience developing a wide range of marketing communications, either on an in\-house team or at a large\-scale global agency
* Ability to manage and prioritise multiple projects, communicate effectively with non\-design stakeholders, and deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced environment
* An outstanding portfolio, showcasing a strong foundation in fundamental design principles
* Experience designing across multiple platforms, including digital and print
* Experience working within brand and design systems
* Experience collaborating with marketing and other stakeholders
* Fluency in Figma
* Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere, Canva, Google Slides, Google Docs, and Microsoft Office Suite


**Nice\-to\-haves**


* Experience in healthcare and technology; video production using AI tools
* Process\-oriented mindset with an ability to identify opportunities to streamline creative production
* Degree or certification in design and video production
* Demonstrated success in multimedia campaigns (stretch)


**Ability to commute/relocate:**


* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)


**Interview Process:**



* Connect with Talent Acquisition


* Meet with the Hiring Manager


* Behavioral Interview(s)


* Case Study


* Interview with Senior Leadership



* Subject to change


**About Cohere Health:**



Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform delivers AI\-powered solutions that streamline access to quality care by improving payer\-provider collaboration, cost containment, and healthcare economics. Cohere Health works with over 660,000 providers and handles over 12 million prior authorisation requests annually. Its responsible AI auto\-approves up to 90% of requests for millions of health plan members.



With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we've further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI\-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real\-time. By unifying pre\-service authorisation data with post\-service claims validation, we're creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer\-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately.



Cohere Health's innovations continue to receive industry\-wide recognition. We've been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022\-2025\), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 \& 2024\. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners, Cohere Health drives more transparent, streamlined healthcare processes, helping patients receive faster, more appropriate care and higher\-quality outcomes.



The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. We believe that diverse, inclusive teams make the most impactful work. Cohere is deeply invested in ensuring that we have a supportive, growth\-oriented environment that works for everyone.


**We can't wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!**


**Equal Opportunity Statement:**



Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it's personal.

Job Description

***Senior Manager, Software Engineer Integration – SRE***

***The Opportunity***

* *Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\-year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.*
* *Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.*
* *Drive innovation and execution excellence. Join a team that is passionate about using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making and create custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.*

*Our Technology Centres focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centres are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.*

*A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in the growth, success, and well\-being of our people to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging, to managing critical emergencies. Together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centres.*

***Role Overview***

*Help us build the Integration enterprise platform—and make hundreds of engineers happier every day. We’re building something ambitious: a federated Integration Platform that gives developers and data teams intuitive, self‑service way to consume, with real‑time insights—all wrapped in secure, scalable automation.*

*If you love creating frictionless engineering experiences, designing systems that “just work,” and turning complex platform capabilities into simple, joyful interfaces, you’ll feel right at home.*

*Security matters deeply here—every workflow, every policy, every interaction. You’ll help bake in security\-by\-design while still keeping things fast and developer\-friendly.*

***What will you do***

*Lead with experience and systems thinking: You’ll create the core elements of the Integration Platform—modular interfaces, intuitive onboarding flows, clear access patterns, and simple ways to understand platform health and status. *Turn complexity into clarity: You’ll design self\-service experiences and workflows that abstract away the hard parts of provisioning, accessing, and integrating with platforms. You’ll translate logs, events, and orchestration outputs into signals that humans can understand instantly*

*Give people insight and confidence: You’ll help enable meaningful dashboards, telemetry views, and signals that tell users what’s happening, why it matters, and what they should do next—whether they’re engineers, analysts, or leader*

*Explore better ways of working with AI: You’ll look for opportunities to augment engineering experiences with AI: better guidance, smarter recommendations, clearer context, and more natural interactions. And you’ll help ensure this is done responsibly and securely*

*Be a partner and facilitator: You’ll work closely with architects, engineers to understand their needs, align on problems, test ideas quickly, and close the loop with clear updates. You’ll help create a working culture that values communication, curiosity, and continuous learning*

*Provide leadership through clarity and empathy: You’ll guide others toward better UX patterns, stronger security practices, and more coherent platform standards. You’ll help shape technical direction while balancing multiple perspectives: users, platform owners, security, and business goals*

* *A strong engineering background with experience in platform engineering, developer tooling, or internal platforms*
* *A mindset focused on usability, clarity, simplification, and systems design—not just implementation*
* *Comfort moving across technologies and learning new tools as needed*
* *An automation\-oriented approach and familiarity with modern Platform Engineering \& DevOps practices*
* *Experience designing experiences for developers or internal users through portals, workflows, APIs, or tooling*
* *A security\-first mindset: understanding identity, access, guardrails, and secure patterns*
* *Experience creating meaningful telemetry and insights for users*
* *Strong communication skills: the ability to facilitate workshops, explain decisions, gather feedback, and guide others*
* *Comfort working in Scrum and in evolving environments*

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher\-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting\-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.


**Our Values**


**Customers**



We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.


**Action**



We make ‘thoughtfully fast’ decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.


**Team Spirit**



We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.


**Innovation**

**Excellence**

In our pod model, product management, design, and engineering sit together as one autonomous unit that owns a product surface end\-to\-end, from discovery through production observability. Your pod will work on core commerce capabilities — product catalog, pricing and quoting, order management, payment processing, ERP integrations, or buyer experience — depending on the pod's domain. As the pod's technical leader, you'll champion AI\-augmented development practices — AI pair\-programming, automated code review, LLM\-assisted testing, AI\-driven incident triage — while keeping humans accountable for architecture decisions, customer empathy, and code quality.



You unblock, coach, and elevate — with your hands on the keyboard. You do not assign tickets from the sidelines.


**What You'll Do**


* **Write code and stay hands\-on**  

Actively contribute to the pod's codebase — building features, fixing bugs, tackling complex integrations, and taking on technical spikes. Use AI coding tools to amplify your own output. Your hands\-on work sets the quality bar and keeps you connected to the real challenges your engineers face every day.
* **Lead pod delivery and health**  

Facilitate lightweight rituals (standups, retros, demos) tuned to the pod's cadence — not prescribed ceremony. Ensure the pod ships incremental value every week through trunk\-based development, feature flags, and zero\-downtime releases.
* **Champion AI\-native engineering**  

Drive adoption of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor), LLM\-powered test generation, and automated PR review. Set guardrails so AI accelerates quality, not just velocity. Continuously evaluate emerging AI tools and integrate them into the pod's workflow.
* **Own architecture and system design**  

Set technical direction for the pod's product surface. Conduct design reviews that account for current needs, future scale, and AI/ML integration points. Balance pragmatism with long\-term soundness. In the commerce domain, this means designing for high\-throughput transaction processing, complex pricing logic, multi\-tenant catalog management, and reliable third\-party integrations.
* **Drive cross\-pod alignment**  

Participate in cohort\-level architecture syncs, API contract reviews, and shared platform decisions. Represent the pod's technical roadmap to leadership and ensure consistency across the product organization.
* **Own production health**  

Ensure the pod maintains SLOs, responds to incidents using AI\-assisted triage, and feeds production learnings back into development priorities. Build a culture of blameless postmortems and continuous operational improvement.
* **Co\-own the delivery pipeline**  

Partner with platform engineering on the pod's CI/CD pipeline. Push toward trunk\-based development, canary deploys, infrastructure\-as\-code, and comprehensive observability (logging, tracing, metrics).

Coach engineers through pairing, async code reviews, and stretch assignments. Develop AI fluency across the pod. Provide continuous, specific feedback rather than periodic reviews. Build psychological safety and high engagement in a small, autonomous team.

Job Title: Territory Manager (Merchant Acquisition – Mid\-Market \& Premium)

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a seasoned sales leader for the role of **Territory Manager**. You will be responsible for leading, mentoring, and driving a high\-performing team of 8\-10 Field Sales Executives (FSEs). Your mission is to dominate the regional market by securing POS and EDC placements in high\-street retail, premium hospitality, and mid\-market commercial hubs.

The ideal candidate is a "player\-coach" who can dive into a difficult negotiation alongside an FSE one hour and analyze territory performance data the next.

**Key Responsibilities**

● **Team Leadership \& Performance:** Manage a team of 8\-10 FSEs, ensuring they meet and exceed daily, weekly, and monthly acquisition targets.

● **On\-Ground Coaching:** Spend 60–70% of your time in the field, conducting joint calls to help FSEs close high\-value accounts and improve their pitch quality.

● **Territory Mapping:** Strategically divide the territory to maximize coverage and ensure the team is focusing on high\-TPV (Total Provincial Volume) potential outlets.

● **Key Account Management:** Directly handle relationships with large regional "MUMs" (Multi\-Unit Merchants) and premium outlets that require senior\-level intervention.

● **Retention \& Activation:** Monitor the health of active terminals; work with the team to resolve merchant grievances and prevent "churn" or terminal inactivity.

● **Daily Reporting:** Conduct morning huddles and evening reviews to track funnel movement, deployment status, and KYC compliance.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

● **Experience:** **5 to 7 years** in Sales, with at least **2 years in a people\-management role** (Team Lead or Territory Manager level).

● **Domain Expertise:** Strong background in **Fintech, POS/EDC Sales, or Merchant Acquiring** is mandatory.

● **Segment Experience:** Proven experience in managing sales teams that target the **High\-End or Mid\-Market** segments.

● **Analytical Skills:** Ability to use CRM tools and Excel to track team productivity, activation rates, and "Productivity Per FSE."

● **Hiring \& Training:** Ability to identify sales talent and quickly upskill new joiners on product features and objection handling.

● **Local Intelligence:** Deep geographical knowledge of the assigned territory’s commercial hubs and premium retail pockets.

**Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

● **Team Productivity:** Percentage of the team meeting their individual monthly targets.

● **Segment Mix:** Achievement of a specific ratio of high\-end vs. general trade outlets.

● **Activation Rate:** Ensuring that deployed machines reach the required transaction thresholds within the first 30 days.

● **Retention:** Low terminal de\-installation rates within the territory.

**What We Offer**

● Fixed salary with a high\-performance\-linked override on the total team incentive.

● Leadership development programs and a clear path to **Area Sales Manager** roles.

● Opportunity to lead a team representating a market\-leading fintech brand.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Contracts run businesses. We are unlocking the intelligence inside them.

Contracts define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. Yet in most companies they remain scattered across systems, frozen in PDFs, and forgotten after execution. We believe contracts are one of the most valuable — and most neglected — data assets in a business.


2025 marked our inflection point. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we started turning them into living, searchable, intelligent systems of record. We shipped over 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and built the foundation for Intelligent Contract Management.


2026 will be our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we are going to market with an AI\-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.


This is the moment. And this is the team building it — a Great Place To Work certified company, made with love in Bangalore and Dallas. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.
  

  

To know more, visit www.signeasy.com


**The Core Mandate**


This Founder's Office in this role is essentially an internal transformation agent — not building AI products, but rewiring how the company operates using AI.


**Key Focus Areas**


1\. **Workflow Audit \& AI Opportunity Mapping**


* Map every repeatable, high\-volume internal process
* Identify where AI can augment, accelerate or replace the task
* Prioritize by ROI and implementation effort
* Expected areas for quick wins: Support, CX, Marketing, GTM ops, Finance

2\. **Tool Consolidation \& AI Stack Design**


* Pre\-AI orgs typically run 30–50 fragmented SaaS tools
* Rationalize the stack around AI\-native alternatives
* Build the connective tissue (MCP, APIs, automations) between systems

3\. **Prompt \& Process Institutionalization**


* Turn tribal knowledge into structured, AI\-ready workflows and skills
* Build internal prompt libraries, SOPs, and playbooks
* Make institutional knowledge retrievable by AI, not just humans

4\. **Change Management \& Adoption**


* Train teams to think AI\-first before reaching for manual processes
* Create internal champions in each function

5\. **Measurement**


* Define productivity baselines before and after deployment
* Track time saved, headcount leverage, and output quality
* Report to the founder/board in business terms, not tech terms

6\. **Hiring Bar Reset**


* Redefine job roles and responsibilities across functions for AI fluency
* The right question: does this person think in systems, not just use AI tools?

6\. **Drive execution cadence \& leader accountability**


* Run monthly AI Council readout (1\-page: wins, value delivered, blockers, laggards, decisions needed).
* Publish transparent performance views (leader scorecards, top wins, laggards) in a constructive manner.
  

  

**The Typical 90\-Day Arc**

Phase Timeframe Focus
  

Audit \& Map Days 1–30 Audit workflows, map AI opportunities, identify 3–5 quick wins
  

Deploy \& Build Credibility Days 31–60 Execute quick wins, demonstrate ROI, build internal trust
  

Roadmap \& Scale Days 61–90 Present full transformation roadmap to leadership with business case  

  

  

**The Hardest Part**

It's not the technology — it's organizational inertia. People protect their workflows because workflows \= job security in their minds. Create an environment to assure peace of mind and support them to reimagine their functions in AI\-native era. The only goal here is figuring out new ways of working and new ways to contribute that will get the value delivered to our customers in the most efficient and effective manner. The best CoAI practitioners are as much organizational psychologists as they are AI practitioners.


**Key Success Factors**


* Start with high\-visibility, low\-risk wins to build credibility
* Always frame in business outcomes, not AI capabilities
* Get a sponsor at the leadership level before starting
* Don't boil the ocean — focus beats breadth in the first 90 days
* Document everything: before/after, time saved, errors reduced

* Customer\-Service Agent — Build and ship the production AI agent that handles member FAQs, onboarding, and troubleshooting across our boutique\-homes portfolio.
